svg.text: Inherited contracts × runtime cost-factor catalog × driver-contract routing — pilot rev 3

g.text: Where each cost factor anchors in the V3 entity tree
Eight pilot factors are catalog rows in billing.cost_factors. Straumvakt platform admins extend the catalog without a migration.
Usage-coupled factors: DSOF · REPF (per-kWh) and post-session XTRRF (idle, etc.). All others are flat / periodic / contract-based.
no factors anchor at these tiers
DSOF + REPF + XTRRF are the usage-coupled energy/post-session factors. USRF/USRF_PREM/SPVIVF are flat-shaped.
per-installation retailer contract — siblings on same site can differ
Always present. Ownership lives here too:
— who owns the iron (may differ from operator org_id)
— Issue Engine routes service tickets to the owner
— CHRGRF tariff can be zero (owned outright) or non-zero (rented)
owner_type ∈ {workplace, family_group, self}. When workplace AND wrkpf_tariff_id IS NOT NULL,
resolver emits a WRKPF line — Straumvakt's service fee for handling workplace routing, billed to the workplace.
Driver contracts override factor allocations (Krónan covers REPF up to 200 kWh/month for employee Anna).
V3 keeps three concepts distinct on every charger row:
who physically owns the hardware · gets paid CHRGRF · responsible for service (Issue Engine)
who runs sessions through this hardware · the SaaS tenant on Straumvakt · default = owner
resolved at session-stop via contract chain → cost_centers.payer_org_id|payer_user_id
who actually pays each cost factor for this session · derived; not a column on charger
cost factor anchored at this tier
cost center: Org / workplace pays (payer_org_id set)
cost center: driver pays (payer_user_id set, or both null = anonymous driver)
cost center: pays Straumvakt (WRKPF service fees)
cost center: rental beneficiary — owner_org receives (e.g. CHRGRF → N1 when N1 owns the charger)
Pilot doesn't settle inter-org transfers — dashboards show beneficiary; settlement is post-pilot tag F.
Additive migration in Sprint 2.6 alongside Circuit (ADR 0007)
All tables in billing schema unless noted. Inheritance edges shown blue. FK edges shown grey.
1. For each cost_factors WHERE status=active: find anchor entity in session lineage → tariff_definition.
2. Compute amount_ex_vat via compute_rule. Apply VAT.
3. Resolve contract at deepest scope tier; walk parent_contract_id chain (child overrides parent).
4. Apply driver_contract overrides (deepest scope wins). WRKPF emitted if workplace contract active.
5. Allocate per priority. kwh_cap rules read accumulator. Spillover priority handles overflow.
6. Every factor allocated, or session-stop ERRORS. Atomic write of billing_lines + accumulators.
SCENARIO 1 · KRÓNAN-EMPLOYEE ANNA AT KRÓNAN WORKPLACE SITE
Workplace absorbs everything · driver pays zero · WRKPF emitted as Straumvakt's service fee · charger owned by Krónan
(owned outright by Krónan; no rental fee)
SCENARIO 2 · ANONYMOUS DRIVER AT N1 PUBLIC DC SITE
Site contract splits: drivers pay DSOF + XTRRF · N1 absorbs REPF + SPVIVF · charger owned by N1 · no driver contract → no WRKPF
(N1 owns the charger; no rental fee)
SCENARIO 3 · ANNA AT N1 · MID-MONTH · REPF CAP SPILLS · CHARGER OWNED BY N1
DriverContract overrides REPF to Krónan up to 200 kWh/month · accumulator at 180/200 → 20 kWh remain · overflow goes to driver
SITE — N1 Reykjavík West (same as Scenario 2)
Period accumulator after this session: 200/200 — cap reached. Next session this month: 100% of REPF goes to driver.
SCENARIO 4 · RENTAL · CHARGER OWNED BY N1, OPERATED BY KRÓNAN, RENT COVERED BY WORKPLACE
Driver A's CHRGRF rental fee (paid to N1) is routed to Krónan workplace via driver contract · Issue Engine routes service to N1 (owner)
DSOF, REPF, XTRRF, SPVIVF as Scenario 1
(Driver A holds the rental contract with N1)
Krónan workplace pays (DSOF + REPF + XTRRF + SPVIVF):
Three concepts visible in one row: OWNER (N1 — gets CHRGRF), OPERATOR (Krónan — runs the site), PAYER (Krónan workplace — covers driver's rent via contract).
Issue Engine routing reads owner_org_id, not org_id — so a hardware fault routes to N1's service team even at a Krónan-operated site.

svg.text: Pilot rev 3 · ADR 0008 (draft) · 8 cost factors as catalog rows · contracts inherit per scope · driver contracts override per session · accumulator-backed kWh caps · ownership distinct from operator and payer · every factor reaches a cost_center or session-stop fails.
